import json
assert json.loads is json.loads
assert json.dumps is json.dumps
assert json.load is json.load
assert json.dump is json.dump
for name in ['load', 'loads', 'dump', 'dumps']:
    first = getattr(json, name)
    second = getattr(json, name)
    assert first is second
assert json.loads('{"x":3}') == {'x':3}
assert json.dumps({'x':3}, sort_keys=True) == '{"x": 3}'
print('ok')
